title: Dispersion
subtitle: Implied vs realized correlation on the S&P 500 top-50
headline: Tuesday 03 November 2026. COR1M 16.4% (low since 2006), our read from 50 chains 17.3%, realized 7.0%. Implied dispersion 19.1 points with 38 names in earnings; the book at trailing vols is +2.7 points. Top idea: put on the vega-weighted dispersion book.

sections.title: Where correlation trades
paragraphs: The CBOE one-month implied correlation (COR1M) closed at 16.4%, the 82th percentile of its trailing year and the 14th since 2006 (low). Solving the basket identity with today's 30-day ATM vols of the 50 largest S&P 500 names and SPY gives 17.3%, 0.9 points above the CBOE print.

Realized correlation of the basket over the last 21 days: 7.0% (63-day average 5.4%). Implied sits +9.4 points above trailing realized. Since 2015 the premium over the *following* month averaged +0.3 points and was positive on 56% of days; over the last two years it fell to +0.6.
Term structure: COR3M 16.1%, ratio COR1M / COR3M 1.02, inverted: a correlation shock is in progress.

sections.title: The book today
paragraphs: SPY 30-day ATM implied vol 16.8% against a weighted average single-name vol of 35.9%: 19.1 points of implied dispersion. 38 of 50 names report earnings inside the tenor.

Vega-weighted dispersion book (long 50 single-name variances, short index variance, Mag 7 = 53% of vega): breakeven realized correlation 17.3% if singles realize their implied, 22.4% if they realize 10% more. If every leg realizes its trailing 21-day vol the book makes +2.7 points per unit of index vega (singles -3.0, index +5.6).

Crash corner of the scenario grid (correlation 80%, singles realizing 1.5x implied): -13.8 points. A crash raises single-name vol and correlation at once, so the index leg loses faster than the single legs gain.

sections.title: Why correlation is where it is
paragraphs: Pairwise 63-day correlation: 24% inside the Mag 7, 7% among the other names, 4% between the two groups. The Mag 7 carry 65% of the basket's variance for 53% of its weight.

The first principal component explains 19% of the basket's return variance (35-45% in 2020-2022). That share and COR1M move together (correlation +0.60 since 2015): one strong market factor means expensive index options and high implied correlation; today's giants trade on their own stories.

sections.title: The short correlation swap, and what it really is
paragraphs: Selling a one-month correlation swap at the COR1M strike every 21 trading days since 2015: 141 trades, +0.4 points per trade on average, 57% winners, worst -46.1 points in June 2016, max drawdown -148.4 points. Gross of a bid-ask that runs several points.

Regressed on the S&P return of the same month, the swap P&L moves +2.11 points per 1% of index move and +0.53 more per 1% on the way down (R² 0.46); its correlation with a short 15-delta put sold at the VIX is +0.43. In the 21 months where the index fell more than 3% the swap lost -17.3 points against +0.4 overall. Selling correlation is selling crash insurance with a different label.

ideas.title: Put on the vega-weighted dispersion book
ideas.direction: long single-name variance, short index variance
ideas.condition: Implied dispersion 19.1 pts; 38 names in earnings; breakeven correlation 17.3%
ideas.thesis: At trailing realized vols the book makes +2.7 points per unit of index vega. Single names are realizing below their implied because earnings are priced but not printed: the trade pays only if the prints move the stocks.

ideas.title: Buy correlation (short dispersion) as a crash hedge
ideas.instrument: receive the 1m correlation swap, or short singles / long index variance
ideas.condition: COR1M at 16.4%, bottom quintile; COR1M / COR3M 1.02
ideas.thesis: The hedge costs the premium: +1.7 points per month on average in this bucket. It pays when correlation jumps; the best month for the buyer in this bucket returned +30.3 points (Oct 2018). Cheap insurance by history, negative carry by construction.

ideas.thesis: When the strike sat in this quintile, implied exceeded the realized correlation of the following month by -1.7 points on average (54% of days). Today's strike is +9.4 points above trailing realized.

method: Ideas are ranked by historical conditional expectation divided by the historical worst case in the same regime. Conditioning variable: the quintile of the COR1M strike since 2006. The dispersion book's worst case is the crash corner of the scenario grid, labelled as a scenario.
caveats: Realized correlation uses an approximate point-in-time top 50 (today's float shares times past prices, rebalanced monthly). A fixed basket of today's names would understate past correlation and show a premium of about 13 points per month that is not there.
Correlation swap P&L is gross: no bid-ask (several points on a real swap), no margin, frozen basket.
Option quotes from Yahoo are delayed; after the close most chains have no bid-ask and IVs come from last trades.
